@comment model_path: name is model name,which is same to the model_path in hikfow_config.json
@comment attribute: model attribute labeles, include index,which can be got from opdevsdk_hikflow_Process,name is used to shown in web
@comment attribute-source: index and name match the trained model metadata: {0: bird_nest, 1: balloon, 2: plastic_bag, 3: smoke, 4: kite, 5: sky_lantern}. name is display only; index is what opdevsdk_hikflow_Process reports and what sel_class filters on
